title: Essential Singularity of the Correlation Length in the Planar XY Model

abstractEnglish:
We prove the Berezinskii–Kosterlitz–Thouless essential singularity for the correlation length of the nearest-neighbor cosine XY model on the square lattice. Let $`m(b)`$ be the mass obtained by taking first the free-box thermodynamic limit and then the separation limit along a coordinate axis. As the inverse temperature b approaches bc from the massive side,

$`\displaystyle \sqrt{b_c-b}\log\frac{1}{m(b)} \longrightarrow A_{\mathrm{XY}},`$

where $`A_{\mathrm{XY}}`$ is a finite, strictly positive model-specific constant.

details.overview: 该稿件研究正方格最近邻余弦XY模型关联长度在临界点附近的行为。作者声称证明了Berezinskii–Kosterlitz–Thouless本质奇点：设m(b)为先取自由盒热力学极限、再沿坐标轴取分离极限所得质量，则当逆温度b从有质量侧趋于b_c时，√(b_c−b)·log(1/m(b)) 趋于有限严格正常数 A_{XY}。摘要表示该极限成立。该结果若成立，将定量刻画XY模型关联长度的本质奇点；但稿件为AI产生的研究手稿，未经独立审查或同行评议。
keyPoints: 研究对象为方格最近邻余弦XY模型的关联长度质量m(b)。

极限沿先自由盒热力学极限、再分离极限的顺序定义。
